newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Zalakeramia executive to sell own shares.
newsitem.headline: Zalakeramia executive to sell own shares.

text.p: Hungarian tile manufacturer Zalakeramia Rt said on Wednesday that its general director Gyorgy Katona gave an order (to a brokerage) for the sale of 1,000 Zalakeramia shares he owned.
On Tuesday Zalakeramia shares finished at a record high of 8,500 forints on the Budapest Stock Exchange following news of acquisition plans.
Zalakeramia will hold an extraordinary general meeting on February 12 to discuss issues related to its planned new acquisitions. It said three companies were of serious interest.
